title: Senior Data Analyst
description: Position - Senior Data Analyst Location - Madhapur, Hyderabad Experience - 5+ years Overview We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst who combines strong analytical skills with hands-on experience building reports and dashboards directly in Omni . In this role, you will work closely with US leadership and cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, develop reliable reporting, and turn complex data into useful business insights. You will take ownership of analytical deliverables, from defining requirements and understanding source data to developing, validating, and maintaining reports. The ideal candidate is comfortable investigating data independently, questioning inconsistencies, and understanding the business logic behind each metric. You should be able to explain what the data shows, why it matters, and how it supports business decisions. Direct report development experience in Omni is essential. Experience in other BI tools is valuable but does not replace this requirement. Key Responsibilities Omni Reporting and Dashboard Development Build, maintain, and enhance reports and dashboards directly in Omni for business, operational, and management reporting. Translate stakeholder requirements into clear metrics, reporting logic, and intuitive visualizations. Develop reports that allow users to explore relevant trends, investigate exceptions, and monitor performance. Review and improve existing reporting for accuracy, usability, consistency, and performance. Data Analysis and Business Understanding Write and optimize SQL queries to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from multiple datasets. Develop a thorough understanding of product workflows, business processes, and the relationships between source data and reported results. Identify trends, anomalies, and performance gaps, and communicate findings with relevant business context. Work with stakeholders to clarify ambiguous requirements and agree on consistent definitions for KPIs and business metrics. Data Quality and Collaboration Validate reports against underlying datasets and business rules before release. Investigate discrepancies, identify root causes, and coordinate with data engineering and product teams to resolve issues. Collaborate with data engineers to ensure reporting datasets are complete, reliable, and structured for analytical use. Document metric definitions, calculations, data sources, assumptions, and reporting dependencies. Ownership and Stakeholder Communication Manage analytical assignments from requirement gathering through delivery and ongoing improvement. Communicate progress, dependencies, and issues proactively. Present findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Work independently while maintaining regular collaboration with US leadership and stakeholders. Essential Skills and Experience 5+ years of relevant experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a similar role. Direct, hands-on experience developing reports and dashboards in Omni , including creating or modifying reporting logic and validating results. Strong SQL proficiency, including complex joins, CTEs, aggregations, window functions, and query troubleshooting. Experience delivering reporting solutions from business requirements through development, validation, and stakeholder review. Sound understanding of data modeling, relational databases, and data warehousing concepts. Demonstrated ability to investigate data issues and translate analytical findings into clear business insights. Strong attention to detail and accountability for the accuracy of reporting outputs. Clear communication skills and experience working directly with business stakeholders. Ability to prioritize work, manage competing requirements, and deliver with minimal supervision. Availability to collaborate with US counterparts during designated collaboration hours. Preferred Skills and Exposure Snowflake: Experience querying warehouse data and working with datasets used for analytics and reporting. Fivetran: Familiarity with data ingestion pipelines, refresh schedules, and their impact on reporting availability and accuracy. Medallion architecture: Understanding of Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers and how data progresses into business-ready reporting datasets. Python: Experience supporting data analysis, validation, or repetitive-task automation. Git/GitHub: Familiarity with version control for SQL, analytical code, or related documentation. Experience supporting SaaS products, financial services, or the automotive Finance & Insurance (F&I) industry. Educational Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a related discipline. Candidates with equivalent relevant professional experience will also be considered. What We Offer Direct collaboration with US leadership and experienced data and product teams. Ownership of reporting solutions that support business and product decisions. Opportunity to work with modern analytics and cloud data platforms. Exposure to the automotive F&I industry and SaaS product environment. Scope to contribute to reporting standards, data quality, and analytical practices. Application Requirements Please highlight your Omni development experience in your application, including: The types of reports or dashboards you personally developed. Your responsibilities in writing queries, defining reporting logic, and validating results. The business requirements addressed and how the reports were used. Candidates should be prepared to discuss a specific Omni reporting project and explain their individual contribution. Any examples shared must exclude confidential or proprietary information. Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month Work Location: In person

title: Business Analyst - Training & Support
description: Department: Product & Implementation Experience: 2–5 years (flexible for candidates with relevant skills) About the Role We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused Business Analyst to support the successful adoption and ongoing use of our enterprise software platform. This role will primarily focus on product training, user onboarding, functional support, and issue resolution following the software launch. The ideal candidate should be comfortable understanding complex software workflows, simplifying them for different audiences, and helping users confidently navigate the platform. The individual will work closely with the Product, Implementation, Development, and Business teams to ensure a seamless transition from implementation to ongoing product usage. Key Responsibilities 1. Product Training & User Enablement Develop a comprehensive understanding of the software's modules, features, workflows, and business processes. Conduct virtual and in-person product training sessions for internal teams, clients, and other stakeholders. Simplify complex product functionality and business workflows into easy-to understand training content. Create and maintain user guides, training presentations, FAQs, walkthroughs, and other learning resources. Deliver role-based training tailored to different user groups and their responsibilities within the software. Conduct refresher sessions and communicate new features, enhancements, and workflow changes to existing users. Collect training feedback and continuously improve training effectiveness. 2. Post-Launch Functional Support Serve as a primary point of contact for functional queries and user assistance following software implementation. Assist users in navigating the platform, understanding workflows, and resolving day to-day functional challenges. Investigate reported issues, reproduce errors, and distinguish between user errors, configuration issues, and potential product defects. Document support tickets with clear descriptions, reproduction steps, screenshots, and business impact. Coordinate with Product and Development teams to escalate technical issues and track them through resolution. Maintain clear communication with users regarding issue status, workarounds, and resolutions. Identify recurring support issues and recommend improvements to training materials, documentation, or product functionality. 3. Product Knowledge & Business Analysis Develop a strong understanding of business workflows and how they are supported within the software. Work with the Product and Implementation teams to understand new functionality, enhancements, and configuration changes. Translate user feedback and operational challenges into clearly documented business requirements or improvement recommendations. Support functional testing and validation of product enhancements before they are released to users. Assist in identifying gaps between expected and actual system behavior. Maintain updated functional documentation as the software continues to evolve. 4. User Adoption & Continuous Improvement Support post-launch stabilization and help users transition smoothly to the software. Monitor user feedback, support trends, and common areas of confusion to identify opportunities for improvement. Collaborate with stakeholders to improve product usability and overall user experience. Track training effectiveness, support resolution trends, and user satisfaction. Contribute to building a scalable knowledge base and structured support process. Required Skills & Qualifications 2–5 years of experience in Business Analysis, Application Support, Product Training, Functional Consulting, or a related role. Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical or functional concepts to non-technical audiences. Experience delivering software training, product demonstrations, or end-user onboarding sessions. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities. Ability to understand complex business workflows and translate them into clear documentation and training content. Familiarity with ticket management, issue tracking, and documentation tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, ClickUp, or Confluence. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple user requests. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a customer-centric approach. Willingness to independently learn new product functionality and adapt to evolving business requirements. Preferred Qualifications Experience working with enterprise SaaS platforms or workflow-driven business applications. Experience supporting enterprise software implementations and post-go-live stabilization. Familiarity with UAT, functional testing, defect tracking, and release management. Experience creating training videos, knowledge-base articles, and structured learning materials. Exposure to change management, user adoption, and continuous process improvement. Experience supporting software used in industries such as insurance, financial services, or enterprise operations would be an advantage. What Success Looks Like Users are confident in navigating the software and performing their day-to-day activities. Training sessions are structured, engaging, and effective for different user groups. Functional queries and support requests are addressed accurately and within agreed timelines. Recurring issues are identified, documented, and reduced through proactive training or product improvements. Product documentation and knowledge resources remain accurate and up to date. Software adoption and user satisfaction improve following implementation. Ideal Candidate Profile We are looking for someone who is analytical like a Business Analyst, engaging like a Product Trainer, and solution-oriented like a Functional Support Consultant. The right candidate should demonstrate strong learning ability, product curiosity, clear communication, patience with end users, and ownership of problems through resolution. Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹65,000.00 per month Work Location: In person

Practical use of AI tools to accelerate requirement drafting, test case generation and documentation.
